components.result: 72 operations, 0 routed to Go, 772 matched fixtures; no findings

limits.fixture_html_marker: CONTENT_OVERSIZED_HTML: original exact content asserted then replaced by UTF8 length + SHA256; repeat reconstructs real request from recorder constant
limits.native_jsonresponse: Only oversized cases adapt actual Django JsonResponse.json() into recorder Response.data; no source response/middleware modification
limits.binary: QUJDRA== (ABCD) and PHNjcmlwdD4= (<script>) ignored by read-only field; create null/update existing seed-doc bytes unchanged
limits.html: App POST script/on-event stripped without wrapper; API PATCH lxml wraps sibling paragraphs in div before sanitation. 10MiB size rejection and sanitizer exception are not claimed HTTP-covered; normal5MiB middleware boundary prevents the former.
